name: Jishvi
title: Son of Asher
summary: Jishvi was one of the sons of Asher, Jacob's son through Zilpah, Leah's maidservant. He is mentioned among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family. As a patriarch in the lineage of Asher, he is part of the history of Israel's twelve tribes.

keyEvents.title: Born as a son of Asher
keyEvents.description: Jishvi was born as one of the sons of Asher, who himself was the son of Jacob and Zilpah. He belonged to the broader family that formed the foundation of Israel's twelve tribes.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Ishvi was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt during the famine, when Joseph was vizier in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Asher's lineage
keyEvents.description: Ishvi is recorded as part of Asher's lineage in the Book of Numbers, where the tribes of Israel were counted in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Listed among Asher's sons in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Ishvi is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles as part of Asher's genealogy, confirming his place in the tribal history of Israel.
